_about: Fallout teardown (mhvnsnt/teardown-fallout, wave-2 step 1.2) — the numeric layer under the companion-judgement fragment (#333): PATTERNS ONLY, no instanced companions, no final numbers. Donor shape at systems level (Fallout companion affinity): acts accrue affinity in delta classes, thresholds convert accrued affinity into consequences, credit is windowed by cooldown discipline while the FACTS are kept forever, and refusal is announced in person before it binds. All values are marked BALANCING-PASS: the donor-evidenced RATIOS between classes are the transferable content; absolute numbers are set in the balancing pass, never invented by the wiring.

capUntil._note: The stall field: an act class can be capped until a story condition clears. Ships empty of instances.

cooldownDiscipline: facts kept; credit windowed — an act always records, but repeated acts inside the window earn no further threshold credit

deltaClasses._note: delta class x size class grid; cell values are ratios (BALANCING-PASS), positive classes accrue toward admiration thresholds, negative toward refusal thresholds

thresholdPattern._note: 4 positive even-spaced thresholds / 2 negative thresholds, mapped to the #333 judgement fragment's four threshold consequences (mochiichao/companion-judgement/v1, lands as judgement-fragment.json). Threshold VALUES are BALANCING-PASS.

warningRule: refusal is announced in person before it binds — the companion says it, in scene, before the consequence takes effect
